long_biography.plain_text:
The 2019 partnership with Oakley Capital marked the commercial payoff from Tom Schröder's work on a simple consumer problem: making one gift card redeemable across many retailers. He and Valentin Schütt had founded Seven Miles in 2014, combining physical distribution with a digital platform under brands including Wunschgutschein and WishCard. By the transaction, the network linked more than 500 brands to most major German retailers.

Oakley acquired a majority stake while retaining the founders as partners, then built a new executive team as Schröder moved from daily management to an advisory role. He later concentrated his capital-allocation work in FIL Bros Family Office. The office now combines direct company investments with property projects, shares and bonds, reflecting his transition from operating a consumer platform to managing a diversified investment structure.
